text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain sends suggestions to Gulf Arab states' four-member mediation committee, set up to improve relations between Bahrain and Qatar soured over a territorial dispute.
- Bahrain's stock market is growing, but needs aggressive stimulation to strengthen it.
- Gulf Internaional Bank reports a record $94.5 million net profit in 1996.
- National Bank of Bahrain posts a 13.6 million dinar net profit in 1996.
